cases.label: The Burst Address
cases.narrative: This address sent a high volume of transactions in a compressed time window during off-peak hours. The tx_burst_score places it in the 95th percentile of all addresses in the snapshot. Combined with sub-30-minute inter-transaction intervals, this is consistent with automated mixing or layering activity.
cases.demo_walkthrough: Search '17ebdd724dbfe21e' → CRITICAL badge → WalletDetail shows 'Extreme burst' + 'Rapid consecutive transactions' → GraphExplorer shows dense output fan-out

cases.label: The Cluster Link
cases.narrative: This HIGH-scored address shares transaction burst patterns with Case A. Co-spend clustering links addresses that share transaction inputs — suggesting the same controlling entity. A human investigator would not catch this across thousands of addresses manually.
cases.demo_walkthrough: Click '761d189d93e7bac2' → GraphExplorer → expand 1 hop → shared transaction node connecting A and B → 'co-spend heuristic surfaces entity linkage automatically'

cases.label: The P2P Node
cases.narrative: One of 20 addresses with P2P simulation signals. In production with legal authorization, this represents a network-level IP cluster correlation. The SIMULATED banner is always visible — judges cannot mistake simulation for real evidence.
cases.demo_walkthrough: Click '558e45a2f878bd09' → P2P panel → '⚠ SIMULATED DATA' banner → IP_CLUSTER_XX → 'Phase 2: real network telemetry with FIU-IND written authorization'
